Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.devices
Metrics.Description: Windows Autopilot device identities, by enrollment state and group tag (capped to top tags by device count, see maxGroupTags).

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.profile.assignments
Metrics.Description: Windows Autopilot deployment profile group assignment count, by profile.

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.profile.count
Metrics.Description: Windows Autopilot deployment profiles, by device type and whether pre-provisioning (white glove) is allowed.

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.profile.esp_timeout_minutes
Metrics.Description: Windows Autopilot deployment profile Enrollment Status Page install-progress timeout, by profile.

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.profile.setting
Metrics.Description: Windows Autopilot deployment profile config-drift-relevant boolean settings (1=enabled, 0=disabled), by profile and setting.

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.stale_contact.count
Metrics.Description: Windows Autopilot device identities whose lastContactedDateTime is older than the stale-contact threshold, by group tag.

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.sync_age_seconds
Metrics.Description: Seconds since Windows Autopilot last synced device registrations from the OEM/partner (windowsAutopilotSettings.lastSyncDateTime).

Metrics.Name: intune.autopilot.sync_status
Metrics.Description: Windows Autopilot device-registration sync status (value 1 for the current bounded status bucket).
